title: Page 313
transc:
1  22nd 
Jno Horner NY  Washn Mar. 21st 1865
Grapes harsh plug for Palsy Dec Mc Callum Supt of
Military Welch zebra Shelter I have received the rambling dispatch
from Jupiter Black zodiac Virgin Has rolling stock sufficient to
supply an opal of Plunge William Waldo spit with the
usual proportion of Pacific Pekin Whig and Nuptial Pedlar over
a distance of Plug Publish and Laugh spoons Pekin been
sent to Flora Star If not more should be sent
at once Violet I have informed the Lieutenant Shelby that
you are attending to this having received your instructions from
Kidnap directly at Germany and that all that is possible
is being done to get forward a sufficient supply yoke
Meigs Bender zebra Fanny The above was just handed in
another Fanny harrow Plank to same zebra I am of
opinion that it will be impossible to ship enough whole
Palmyra to stock Plug wine and Lamp spoons of wiley
in time zebra I advise that the Palmetto be taken
to Vermin and running gear and platforms only shipped for
the present youth Meigs Belcher If Shelton M is not
in the city deliver to his agents there for attention
